g.text: Clamp share: one recording, peaking at -5.5 dBFS as recorded. Error: 7-file subset, Voxtral, coverage CER/WER (-6 dB not run).

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: --gain auto leaves a file already peaking above -6 dBFS alone, because 0 dB is the Japanese optimum, +6 dB is marginally worse on Japanese

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: and puts this recording's peak at full scale; the English improvement rests on 2 files. Source: input-level.md.
